t: This is Gerald Road, a street in Belgravia, in the City of Westminster. It's a quiet residential stretch, and the sort of place where ordinary lives get lived out behind the front doors. The one person the record ties to it is Penelope Samantha Lort-Phillips, born in 1964, who lived here. That's all the material says about her, so I won't guess at more. Take it as a street worth a slow look at the houses, knowing that someone with a recorded name once called one of them home.
